title: Government Law College IPR Journal
subtitle: Annual Peer-Reviewed Journal on Intellectual Property, Innovation & Tech Policy
overview: The IPR Journal, published by the Intellectual Property Rights Cell of Government Law College, Mumbai, is a student-edited, faculty-guided academic journal dedicated to high-calibre scholarship in IP law and allied fields including competition law, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and technology policy. Every submission undergoes a stringent double-blind peer review to maintain academic precision and originality.

cfp.title: Guidelines for Submissions
cfp.eligibility: Open to law students (LL.B., B.A. LL.B., LL.M.), research scholars, academicians, and legal practitioners across India and internationally.

categories.description: Comprehensive doctrinal or empirical analysis with constructive policy suggestions and rigorous citation.
Critical perspectives on emerging issues, legislative amendments, or statutory debates.
Analytical breakdown of landmark Indian or international intellectual property judicial decisions.

formatting.citation: Bluebook (21st Edition) strictly. Footnotes only (speaking footnotes strictly discouraged).
formatting.font: Times New Roman (Size 12 for Body, Size 10 for Footnotes)
formatting.spacing: 1.5 Line Spacing for Main Body, 1.0 for Footnotes
formatting.headerFooter: Header with Journal Name; Footer with Page Numbers
formatting.plagiarism: Strict threshold below 10% (excluding standard statutory citations)

submissionProtocol: Manuscripts must be completely anonymized (no author name or institutional identifiers in the document body).
A separate Cover Letter specifying Title, Author Name(s), Designation, Institutional Affiliation, Contact Number, and Email must be attached.
Submit in .docx / .doc format via the official IPR Cell submission portal.
Zero registration or publication processing fee.
